Name: Canned Farm
Author: Lilaoliu
Description:
[size=4][b]Canned Farm[/b][/size]

A brand-new farm for the game, including:
[list]
[*]A pre-built barn and coop from day one[/*]
[*]Hidden machines and rewards on the map[/*]
[*]A new NPC[/*]
[*]A shop permanently on the farm[/*]
[*]3 new maps[/*]
[*][b]Daily random bonus[/b]: each day one random farm bonus takes effect:
[list]
[*]Brewing: kegs, preserves jars and casks in the cellar work faster[/*]
[*]Ranching: doubled friendship from petting your animals[/*]
[*]Mushroom: higher quality chance from mushroom logs, and the dehydrator keeps the input quality[/*]
[*]Aquaculture: bigger fish ponds - even legendary fish can breed[/*]
[*]Fishing: double catches in the farm's waters[/*]
[*]Greenhouse: crops grow faster inside the greenhouse[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]罐头农场[/b][/size]

为游戏新添加一个农场，并包含以下内容：
[list]
[*]开局自带一个畜棚和鸡舍[/*]
[*]地图中隐藏的机器和奖励[/*]
[*]一个新NPC[/*]
[*]常驻在农场中的商店[/*]
[*]3 张新的地图[/*]
[*][b]每日随机加成[/b]：每天随机一项农场加成生效，包括：
[list]
[*]酿酒：酒窖里的小桶、罐头瓶、木桶加工更快[/*]
[*]畜牧：抚摸动物获得的好感翻倍[/*]
[*]蘑菇：蘑菇树桩高星概率提高，烘干机按原料星级产出[/*]
[*]养鱼：鱼塘容量更大，鱼王也能繁殖[/*]
[*]钓鱼：农场水域钓获数量翻倍[/*]
[*]温室：温室里的作物加速生长[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]

[*][b]C#（Code / 代码）[/b]：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/CosmosCetus][b]CosmosCetus (WhaleK233)[/b][/url][/*]
[/list]
